'''Chapter 574''' is titled "Portgas D. Ace Dies".

==Cover Page==
[[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] and Animals: [[Nami]] manages to hit [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] while playing [[Wikipedia:Whack-a-mole|Whack-a-Mole]].

==Short Summary==
[[Polo Marco|Marco]] asks [[Galdino|Mr. 3]] to make a key in order to free himself from the [[Seastone]] handcuffs while the rest of the [[Whitebeard Pirates]] and their allies repel [[Sakazuki|Akainu]]'s attacks. Several flashbacks of [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]]'s past are shown before Ace dies smiling, saying he had a happy life.

==Long Summary==
[[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] hugs [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] while taking his last breath. Ace asks Luffy to forgive him for not letting Luffy save him completely. Marco tells Mr. 3 to make him a key so he can take off his [[Seastone]] handcuffs.

While allies and members of the [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] pirates fend off [[Sakazuki|Admiral Akainu]], [[Sengoku]] is forced to subdue [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]], because otherwise Garp would attempt to kill Akainu. Ace's crewmates call a doctor, but Ace says it is too late because his insides have been melted. Many flashbacks from Ace's past are shown in which people commented that if [[Gol D. Roger]] has a kid, that kid should just die.

Ace then says his last words, how he will miss everyone, and how glad he was to be accepted by his friends and to have a family. He also mentions [[Sabo|someone]] dear to him for the first time. In the final flashback, Luffy is crying and Ace tells Luffy that he is never going to die cause he has a little brother to worry about. With that, his [[Vivre Card]] burns completely and a flashback of his mother is shown naming him Gol D. Ace. Both Whitebeard and Garp start to cry. In the final scene, Ace dies in front of Luffy's lap, leaving Luffy alone with a tormented expression on his face, and spelling the end for the Gol D. bloodline.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Polo Marco|Marco]] and [[Vista]] are confirmed to be [[Haki]] users.
*[[Sabo]] is mentioned for the first time.
*[[Portgas D. Ace]], second division commander of the [[Whitebeard Pirates]] and son of the Pirate King [[Gol D. Roger]] dies, making this the very first death of a major character (as well as a D. carrier) outside of a flashback.
*As suggested by the traits of the ones who carry the [[Will of D.]], Ace also dies with a smile.
*With Ace's death, [[Gol D. Roger]]'s bloodline comes to an end.
